claims.verbatim:
Bark Iddo Kimball, West, Trieste, 90 days, with rags, &c,
to A Jaquemot. May 6, in lat 26 45, lon 34 20, spoke bark
Laurele (Fr), from Gambia for Marseilles; no date, lat 36 36,
lon 3 W, spoke brig Thos W Rowland, steering NW; no date,
lat 26 30, lon 40 15, spoke ship Manchester, from Valparaiso
for Liverpool.
